res_forest.description: resource point: a small grove of three snow-dusted spruce trees with red berry bushes and a mossy stump at their feet

res_sand.description: resource point: low mound of pale yellow sand and fine gravel with a few pebbles, flat on the ground

res_water.description: resource point: small round freshwater spring pool of clear blue water ringed with mossy stones, seen from above, flat on the ground

tree_dead.description: single dead bare grey conifer tree with broken branches, frost on the bark

tree_pine.description: single old scots pine tree with a bare reddish trunk and a flat dark green crown dusted with snow

tree_spruce.description: single tall snow-dusted spruce tree, dark green, conical

tree_spruce_b.description: single tall snow-dusted spruce tree, dark green, conical

volcano.description: ice age volcano cone of dark basalt rock, wide base, glowing orange lava crater on top, thin plume of grey smoke rising, snow patches and frozen ash on its lower slopes, cracks with faint orange glow
